data.gist: Knee joints were decalcified, paraffin-sectioned sagittally at 5 µm, stained with Alcian blue and safranin-O, scored by OARSI criteria, and immunostained for collagen type 2.
data.plain: After imaging, bone samples were softened by removing calcium, embedded in wax, and thinly sliced. Standard cartilage stains were used and damage was graded with the established OARSI scoring system; collagen type 2 (the main cartilage protein) was detected by antibody staining.
